## Change

Describe the user-facing change and link the issue.

## Validation

List focused tests, the full pytest suite, lint/format, lock check, image-enabled tests (if relevant), build and strict docs build, with any skips.

## Safety

- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots are synthetic or independently anonymized.
- [ ] No credentials, real device identifiers, raw logs, APK contents or proprietary assets were added.
- [ ] Documentation and supported-hoods evidence labels were updated when needed.
